WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
sl AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id)=1),
s AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-10-05' THEN 'LY' END yr,
   d.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) sales
 FROM sl f JOIN dim_store d USING(store_key) WHERE d.store_id<900 GROUP BY ALL),
r AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-10-05' THEN 'LY' END yr,
   d.store_id, sum(f.refund_net) ret
 FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store d USING(store_key) WHERE d.store_id<900 GROUP BY ALL),
rp AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-10-05' THEN 'LY' END yr,
   store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT c.region, s.yr, round(sum(s.sales),2) sales, round(sum(coalesce(r.ret,0)),2) rets, round(sum(s.sales-coalesce(r.ret,0)),2) net, round(sum(rp.rpt_net),2) rpt_net, round(sum(rp.rpt_sales),2) rpt_sales,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id NOT IN (119,125,129,999) THEN s.sales-coalesce(r.ret,0) END),2) lfl_net
FROM s JOIN cur c USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN r ON r.store_id=s.store_id AND r.yr=s.yr LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.store_id=s.store_id AND rp.yr=s.yr WHERE s.yr IS NOT NULL AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
lines AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1) f
  JOIN dim_store d USING (store_key) WHERE d.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store d USING (store_key) WHERE d.store_id < 900),
x AS (
  SELECT c.region, l.store_id,
    CASE WHEN l.d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY'
         WHEN l.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-10-05' THEN 'LY' END AS yr,
    l.amt
  FROM lines l JOIN cur c USING (store_id))
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN amt END) DESC) AS rank,
  region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_ytd_eur,
  round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN amt END) - 1), 2) AS like_for_like_growth_pct
FROM x WHERE yr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY rank
